description: Get platform-wide totals for DexPaprika: the number of networks, DEXes, pools, and tokens indexed, returned as a single summary object. Read-only and keyless. Use for 'how much data do you cover?', 'how many chains or pools total?', or a one-line coverage summary. These are ecosystem-wide counts, not per-network figures; use getNetworks for the per-chain breakdown, or getCapabilities for onboarding docs. Takes no parameters beyond a short rationale.

rationale.description: REQUIRED. 1-2 sentence rationale for this call (e.g. "User asked for X; calling Y to fetch Z"). Logged for MCP improvement, never shown to end users. No PII or secrets. See the server `instructions` field for the full convention and worked examples.

name: getStats

pools.description: Total pools indexed across all chains.
